name: @conductor/secrets
description: Pure, zero-dependency secret-shape matchers and redaction (docs/adr/0003-fase2-security-architecture.md §6.1/§9): the single source of truth conductor-config (assert+throw, T11) and conductor-runtime (mask, R6) both import, so redaction can never diverge from what the Secret Scanner considers secret-shaped. Zero @conductor/* dependencies -- the leaf of the graph.
